title: D-033 T-C: controller committer identity + queue advance (most sensitive; Stage-3 gate; switch-gated, DEFAULT OFF)
objective: Implement the D-033 design's T-C slice (docs/SUPERVISOR_MANAGEMENT_LAYER_DESIGN.md): the distinct controller committer identity scoped to control-plane + task-branch integration citing run-id (design item I4); wiring next_task.record_advancement + successor dispatch; push/deploy-impossible negative tests; Section 5 refusal tests. This is a genuine ADR-005 git-authority extension and the natural Stage-3 activation gate: switch-gated, DEFAULT OFF, live activation stays behind the owner-only R595 path (D-033-R005 unchanged). Cites D-033-R002 and D-033-R005 as qualifying evidence (freeze-rule section 3). Depends on T-B (M0-T153). The T-B/T-C run queue must be SUCCESSORS-ONLY (DL-1) and is designed to produce the R754 facts 3+7 closing evidence (single-boot verdict-advance-dispatch over a multi-task queue with zero owner touches + the controller-written six-field foreground artifact).
business_reason: D-033-R002/R005: completes the Tier-A ledger chain the management layer needs before the owner can activate staged R595 automation.
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/committer.py (distinct controller committer identity, control-plane + task-branch integration scope, run-id cited in every message; push/deploy structurally impossible)
tools/agent_supervisor/accept_engine.py or cli.py wiring for next_task.record_advancement + successor dispatch
tools/test_agent_supervisor_committer.py (push/deploy-impossible negatives; Section 5 refusal tests; identity-scope mutations)
documented_test_commands: python -m ruff check tools/agent_supervisor/committer.py tools/agent_supervisor/accept_engine.py tools/agent_supervisor/cli.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_committer.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_accept_engine.py
notes: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE CONTRACT (DL-2, proven on M0-T152 runs 08/09): in the final checkpoint JSON, starting_sha and current_sha MUST each be either the FULL 40-hex sha (git rev-parse HEAD in the worktree) or the empty string "" (controller enrichment fills empty envelope fields; any abbreviated sha is refused fail-closed). Same rule for branch/worktree: exact or empty.
